title: Microarray Analysis of RNA and DNA
author: Hajime Fujishima
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kahcsb6

steps.title: Extract RNA and DNA
steps.instruction: Homogenize frozen specimens and extract total RNA and DNA using specific kits according to the manufacturer's protocols.

substeps.instruction: Extract total RNA using QIAGEN RNeasy TM mini kit (QIAGEN).
Extract DNA using QIAamp TM DNA Mini Kit (QIAGEN Inc., Valencia, CA).

steps.title: Reverse Transcribe RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Reverse transcribe 200 ng of total RNA to cDNA using murine leukemia virus reverse transcriptase (Invitrogen Crop., Carlsbad, CA).

steps.title: Prepare Cy-labeled cRNA
steps.instruction: Prepare Cyanine (Cy)-labeled cRNA using T7 linear amplification following the Agilent Low RNA Input Fluorescent Linear Amplification Manual (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Perform Microarray Hybridization
steps.instruction: Fragment the labeled cRNA and hybridize it to a human 8 × 60K whole genome oligo DNA microarray chip (SurePrint G3 Human Gene Expression v3 Microarray Kit, G4851C, Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA) according to the manufacturer's protocol.

steps.title: Scan and Analyze Fluorescent Intensities
steps.instruction: Determine fluorescent intensities using an Agilent DNA Microarray Scanner and analyze the data using Feature Extraction v.10.7.3.1 (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Normalize Expression Data
steps.instruction: Convert expression levels into log 2 values and normalize them to the median of the entire spot array using GeneSpring TM GX11 (Agilent Technologies).

steps.title: Calculate Log 2 Fold Change
steps.instruction: Calculate the log 2 fold change (log 2 FC) in gene expression using Microsoft Excel ® 2016 (Microsoft Corp., Redmond, WA).

steps.title: Analyze Molecular Networks via KeyMolnet
steps.instruction: Analyze molecular networks and pathways using KeyMolnet Viewer program version 6.1 (KM Data; www.km-data.jp).

substeps.instruction: Import the list of Entrez Gene ID and signal intensity data for genes with significantly different expressions between the pCR group and non-pCR group.
Calculate molecular expressions and isolate candidate molecules included in the canonical networks of cancer chemotherapy.

steps.title: Perform Molecular Pathway Analysis
steps.instruction: Identify relations of candidate molecules and canonical pathways using the KeyMolnet algorithm to count overlapping molecular relations.

substeps.instruction: Score the similarity using the formula: Score = - log 2 (Score (p)), where f(x) = CCx · T-CCV-x / TCV (O = overlapping molecular relations between extracted network and canonical pathway, V = molecular relations in extracted network, C = molecular relations in canonical pathway, T = total molecular relations (~90,000 sets), and X = sigma variable for incidental agreements).
Consider a score of more than 20 as statistically significant.
